results.detail: New Chrome tab directly loaded task-local file: entry; URL and wide screenshot retained.
Tab reaches the skip link and visible focus evidence is retained.
Default-deny blocks restore before explicit grant.
Fixed non-sensitive text appears only after explicit confirmation.
Explicit grant permits preview but not a receipt without exact CONFIRM.
Exact CONFIRM creates only a current-page synthetic receipt.
Repeated CONFIRM reports an idempotent existing receipt without new recovery.
Revoke returns to fail-closed and clears the recovery receipt.
Simulated failure clears display state and discloses no real save, grant, or restore.
No-reliable-suggestion page retains default-deny and does not fabricate a suggestion.
Restricted/offline page remains blocked and does not read or process content.
Refresh after confirmed display clears text, receipt, and permission state.
Close and reopen task-local page starts with default-deny and no displayed record.
Chrome zoom interaction retained a readable responsive layout; CSS narrow-screen rule is independently checked.
Three-page navigation is local file: navigation only; no HTTP/network route was used.
